title: Australian teen found alive after six days lost in dense bushland without food or water
summary_full: A 17-year-old boy named William went missing while camping and survived for six days in the bushland. He was separated from his friend and lacked a mobile phone, food, and water. Hundreds of volunteers and police searched the area, focusing on challenging terrain and dense vegetation. Eventually, a helicopter spotted his fishing tackle box, leading to his rescue beside a creek.
